description:
Keyword search in gol24.uz news titles and summaries, newest first. Use it for topics, events or names that club_news and person_news cannot resolve ("Ballon d'Or", "Champions League draw", "national team"). For one specific club or person prefer club_news / person_news - they are more precise.
News text is in Uzbek (Latin script), so search Uzbek spellings: "Oltin to'p", "Chempionlar ligasi", "terma jamoa", "Mbappe". Matching is a case-insensitive substring match on title and summary over the last `days` days (default 30, max 90).
Returns up to `limit` items (default 10, max 20) with the same fields as latest_news. An empty list means no match - try a shorter or Uzbek-spelled keyword. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

days.description: Optional. How many days back to search, 1-90 (default 30). Increase it for older events.

query.description: Keyword or phrase, at least 2 characters. Use the Uzbek Latin spelling used on the site, e.g. "Oltin to'p" (Ballon d'Or), "terma jamoa" (national team), "Mbappe".

name: search_news
title: Search News
